_comment: Maintained by the MCSheriffAnya project; PTDL_v2 import file.
name: MCSheriffAnya
author: AnyaSheriff@users.noreply.github.com
description: Minecraft-compatible server written in Rust (MIT, alpha). Java 26.1.2 / protocol 775; partial Bedrock 26.10–26.13 / protocol 944. Binary is included in the panel image. Allocate a UDP port for Bedrock or set BEDROCK_PORT=0. gamemode in server.properties is not implemented; use console commands.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

# Wings: установка идёт в /mnt/server, запуск — в /home/container.
# https://pelican.dev/docs/eggs/creating-a-custom-egg/ — "Install Container Path".
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p config world logs playerdata skins plugins modules

# Создаём ключи до обработки конфигурации панелью. При переустановке
# сохраняем существующие файлы; значения egg панель применяет перед запуском.
if [ ! -e config/server.properties ]; then
    cat > config/server.properties <<'PROPERTIES'
server-port=25565
server-ip=0.0.0.0
online-mode=true
max-players=20
motd=MCSheriffAnya Server
PROPERTIES
fi
if [ ! -e config/mcsa.properties ]; then
    cat > config/mcsa.properties <<'PROPERTIES'
bedrock-port=19132
auth-enabled=true
PROPERTIES
fi
printf '%s\n' 'MCSheriffAnya: data directories ready; binary is supplied by the panel image.'

variables.name: Bedrock UDP port
variables.description: UDP allocation assigned by the host. 0 disables Bedrock. Changing this value does not create an allocation or firewall rule.

variables.name: Java online mode
variables.description: Verify Java accounts. Password login applies only when this is false. Bedrock Xbox policy is configured separately via bedrock-online-mode.

variables.name: Password login
variables.description: Enable built-in password registration/login for offline Java players. Java online-mode and Bedrock bypass this gate.

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Server list description, one line. Unicode text is allowed.
